# CMake file for unit tests
# Author: Lauren Ferguson
# Date: Dec 2017
# Modified by Keith Ballard

# Working directory for testing, which will store all output files 
# generated by the tests. (Subdir of build) 
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/unit_tests/Output)
set(TEST_WORKDIR ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/unit_tests/Output)

file(GLOB_RECURSE _unit_tests "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}" "*.cpp")
set(test_list, "")

foreach(_test ${_unit_tests}) 
  # Get input file name
  get_filename_component(_name ${_test} NAME)
  # Get subdirectory name
  get_filename_component(_dir ${_test} DIRECTORY)
  get_filename_component(_category ${_dir} NAME)

  # Create executable
  STRING(REPLACE ".cpp" "" _name ${_category}_${_name})   # test name prefixed with category
  add_executable(${_name} ${_test})
  set_property(TARGET ${_name} PROPERTY FOLDER unit_tests)
  target_link_libraries(${_name} PRIVATE Utility::Utility)
  
  include(${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake/Utilities.cmake)
  assign_source_group("utility" ${UTILITY_HEADER_LIST})

  # Create test
  add_test(NAME "Unit_Utility_${_name}"   # test name prefixed with Unit and project
    COMMAND ${_name}                              # test executable
    WORKING_DIRECTORY ${TEST_WORKDIR}             # directory to call program from and write output to
    )
  list(APPEND test_list "${_name}")
endforeach()

# This target will compile and run all the unit tests. 
# See: https://stackoverflow.com/questions/733475/cmake-ctest-make-test-doesnt-build-tests
# add_custom_target(unit COMMAND ${CMAKE_CTEST_COMMAND} DEPENDS ${test_list})
# We modify to just build (and not run). This is particularly useful if you 
# want to separate the build of the main code from the building of the tests.
#add_custom_target(unit COMMAND echo "Build all unit tests" DEPENDS ${test_list})
